name: OR-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Suzanne Bonamici running with large financial advantage
Republican challenger Barbara Kahl has raised only about $4,500
Prediction markets price Democratic win at roughly 96%
model.rationale: Bonamici holds a D+20 district with incumbency and a massive fundraising edge, while Kahl has raised almost nothing. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Democratic hold.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending showing a closer race would be the first sign of movement, but nothing currently suggests one.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Suzanne Bonamici seeks another term in a Portland-area district that leans Democratic by about 20 points. She has raised more than $800,000 and holds over $570,000 in cash, while Republican Barbara Kahl has reported only a few thousand dollars in receipts and no outside support.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available, but prediction markets give Bonamici roughly a 96% chance of winning. With the incumbent's advantages in money, name recognition, and district lean, this race sits firmly in the safe Democratic category.
